title: Approvals UI: the request page's 「提交时的内容」 leaves out file fields (and every object-valued field), so an approver cannot see the invoices they approve
body:
domain:ui#2 · os-lizheng · session_012MmDsRT6hvZsQH9dTzn4CA

Filing gate: ① a user-visible defect with reach, split out of #32667. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the lane and grade.

Source: #32667's follow-ups 6820695046 and 6824157397 (hosted tenant, 2026-11-12), `domain:ui#6`'s reading 6829657789, and the os-dev-report 6837020282 on #32667 (PR #32850).

## What happens

An approval request's 「提交时的内容」 block lists the submitted record's scalar fields but leaves out every object- or array-valued one. On an expense claim whose e-invoices are a `file` field with `multiple: true`, the approver sees 报销金额, 报销标题, 费用类别, 报销事由, 发票号码 and 状态, but **not** 电子发票, the one field holding the invoices they are approving. The same claim opened from its own app shows both files.

## Measured cause (`main`)

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/approval-decision/snapshotSummaryPlan.ts` skips every object or array value: `if (value == null || typeof value === "object") continue;`. A file field's value is one of these.

## Why it is its own card

Deciding which object-valued kinds the summary draws (`file`, `address`, `json`, an expanded lookup), how each is rendered (file chips that open or download), and how they count against `SNAPSHOT_SUMMARY_ROWS` is a design choice, not a few-line fix.

## Done when

An approver sees the submitted file fields in 「提交时的内容」 and can open them, with each object-valued kind either drawn or deliberately left out by a stated rule, and pinned.

Dedupe words: approval snapshot summary file field, 提交时的内容 attachment missing, snapshotSummaryPlan object value.
